product_name: Oppo F31 Pro+ 5G (Festival Pink, 12GB RAM, 256GB Storage)
description: 6.8″ Ultra-Bright, Eye-Caring Display: The 17.27cm (6.8 Inch) AMOLED screen delivers cinematic visuals with 1600 nits brightness, 120Hz refresh rate, and 10-bit color depth. With a 93.5% screen-to-body ratio and 2160Hz PWM dimming, it’s built for smooth, vibrant, and eye-friendly viewing anywhere. Five advanced eye-protection technologies ensure comfort day or night—hardware-level blue light reduction, natural-light adaptation, circadian rhythm color adjustment, smart backlight, and visibility optimization. Pro-Grade Camera -Capture True Colors: 50 MP Main Camera and 2 MP Portrait Camera, and a sharp 32 MP Front Camera, this phone turns every shot into a masterpiece. 4K Underwater Videography/photography mode allows users to capture photos and videos underwater. Advanced HDR Algorithm Optimization enhances dynamic range, suppresses highlights, and reduces noise, delivering crisp images even in low light. Capture cinematic moments with ease using Dual-View Video, Live Photos, and Dynamic Capturing, which automatically records video snippets around every click create stunning, professional-grade photos effortlessly. Performance That Powers Every Moment with Snapdragon 7: Qualcomm Snapdragon 7 Gen 3 Mobile Platform × Trinity Engine To ensure smooth performance under high-load applications, in harsh environments, and over extended usage and gaming, backed by a 5219 mm² VC cooling system for sustained performance. Running on ColorOS 15, it’s optimised for 72-month fluency protection to stay fast for years. Power for Days, Safety Guaranteed: Equipped with OPPO’s largest-ever 7000mAh battery, the F31 Pro+ delivers worry-free endurance. From 55 hours of music to 16+ hours of YouTube streaming, it ensures uninterrupted usage. Even with only 5% left, you still get 1.8 hours of calls, giving peace of mind on the longest days. Stay unstoppable with 80W SUPERVOOC lightning-fast charging. Just 5 minutes plugged in provides hours of use, and a full charge completes in just 61 minutes. With self-repairing electrolyte technology, the battery retains over 80% health for 5 years, making it one of the most durable in industry. Always Connected -Communication Without Signal: Powered by the AI LinkBoost 3.0 S1 chip and Hunter Antenna, the F31 Pro+ ensures stronger signals and faster speeds. TÜV Rheinland-certified connectivity guarantees smoother calls and stable performance, even in weak-signal areas. When networks fail, Beacon Link 2.0 enables peer-to-peer Bluetooth voice calls up to 210m—perfect for treks, festivals, or emergencies. Bypass Charging: Smarter, Cooler, Safer: For marathon gaming or extended use, Bypass Charging powers the phone directly, reducing heat and protecting long-term battery health. With this feature enabled in the Settings interface, the charger directly powers the device, by passing the battery storage process and maintaining long-term durability. Military-Grade Protection, Unyielding Defense: Engineered for the toughest conditions, OPPO F31 Pro+ complies with MIL-STD-810H and GJB shock standards. It withstands drops from 1.22m, blazing +71°C heat, freezing -50°C cold, and exposure to sand, salt spray, rain, and ice. A phone is designed not just for daily life, but for every adventure.
